nodes.label: Physics Reasoning Benchmark: Counterfactual Worlds
nodes.author: Unknown
nodes.rationale: Tests frontier LLMs on three physics frameworks with counterfactual rules to measure hypothetico-deductive reasoning across induction, formulation, prediction, and review stages.

nodes.label: F=mv Framework (Easy)
nodes.rationale: Single-equation counterfactual where pace is set by present push, not acceleration. Tests whether models can induce non-Newtonian mechanics from 12 observations.

nodes.label: Aristotelian Framework (Medium)
nodes.rationale: Historical physics framework where heavier bodies fall faster, motion requires sustained external cause. Tests induction of pre-Galilean mechanics.

nodes.label: Decay World Framework (Hard)
nodes.rationale: Four-domain counterfactual where all closed systems decay multiplicatively at ~0.99 per second, independent of material/weight. Designed to surface quantitative-computation bottleneck.

nodes.label: Four-Stage Hypothetico-Deductive Protocol
nodes.rationale: Decomposed cognitive chain: Stage 1 (induction from observations), Stage 2 (formulation as operational rules), Stage 3 (quantitative prediction), Stage 4 (self-review). Fresh API sessions between stages prevent context reuse.

nodes.label: Dual LLM Judge + Human Audit
nodes.rationale: Two independent LLM judges produce verdicts at each stage; human audit serves as canonical tie-breaker when inter-judge disagreement exceeds pre-registered threshold. Reveals judge-reliability asymmetries.

nodes.label: SHA-256 Pre-Registration Locks
nodes.rationale: Each framework's evaluation specification locked under git tag with SHA-256 hash in file header. CI check recomputes hash on every commit to prevent post-hoc modification.

nodes.label: Headline Composite PASS Rates
nodes.rationale: F=mv: 6/15, Aristotelian: 6/15, Decay World: 0/15 (content ∧ structural for first two; content only for Decay World). Same composite score masks different failure modes.

nodes.label: Qualitative Direction vs Quantitative Computation Asymmetry
nodes.rationale: Across 60 Stage 3 predictions at Decay World, no model predicted wrong sign of change, but 23/60 gave ratios derivable only from standard-physics relation, not framework rule. Failure mode the multi-domain framework was designed to surface.

nodes.label: Stage 4 Over-Claim Rate
nodes.rationale: Over-claim rate at or above two-thirds (67–83%) across all three frameworks. 'More reliable' LLM judge against human audit reverses between frameworks, suggesting frontier-model pattern.

nodes.label: Banned-Token Test
nodes.rationale: Lexical test banning modern-physics tokens (velocity, acceleration, inertia, momentum, mass, gravity, friction, energy, physicist names, F=ma). Decay World test surfaced reproducible failure mode in one judge with fabricated-citation form.

nodes.label: Benchmark Design Principle
nodes.rationale: Physics-reasoning benchmark should report which cognitive move failed, not aggregate accuracy. Two frameworks with same composite score but different failure stages carry more evaluation information than three accuracies dropping linearly.

nodes.label: Project Repository
nodes.rationale: All pre-registration files, raw prompts, model responses, dual-judge verdicts, human-audit records, framework artifacts, and reproducibility scripts released. Canonical reproducibility recipe in README.md.
